hooks.name: markdown-labels nudge
hooks.description: After the agent saves a Markdown file, ask it to run the markdown-labels skill when the document is long and has no label sidecar.

action.prompt: You just saved the Markdown file named in file_path below. If it has 400 or more words and at least two headings, and no label sidecar exists at <project root>/.mymd/<path of the file relative to the project root>.json, run the markdown-labels skill on it now. Otherwise ignore this instruction.

hooks.name: markdown-labels anchors
hooks.description: Stamp text anchors into a label sidecar the agent just wrote, so its labels survive later edits.
